defs.def: to become shorter, or make sth shorter, by sliding sections inside one another （使）叠套缩短，叠缩

ex.s: Currently, China operates the world’s largest and most powerful radio telescope, the FAST telescope, completed in 2016.
ex.t: 目前，中国运行着世界上最大、最强大的射电望远镜——2016年建成的 FAST（天眼）望远镜。

ex.s: The 500-metre dish of the “Eye of Heaven”, as it is known, is being used in the search for dark matter, thought to be composed of subatomic particles invisible to ordinary telescopes.
ex.t: 这个被称为“天眼”的500米口径球面射电望远镜，正被用于搜寻暗物质——据认为暗物质由普通望远镜看不见的亚原子粒子组成。

ex.s: The Hubble and the space telescopes constructed after it will allow us to see further and further into space.
ex.t: 哈勃望远镜以及其后建造的太空望远镜将让我们能看得越来越深远的太空。

ex.s: In 1990, the Hubble Space Telescope was launched into orbit.
ex.t: 1990年，哈勃太空望远镜被送入轨道。

defs.def: to reduce sth so that it happens in less time 缩短，精简，压缩（成 … ）

ex.s: Using ever-larger radio telescopes as our eyes, we will one day be able to look back to a time in the very early universe, before the existence of light.
ex.t: 用越来越大的射电望远镜作我们的眼睛，有一天我们将能回望宇宙极早期、光尚未存在的时代。
